import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "user": ["alice", "bob", "carol", "dave"],
    "amount": [50, 150, 200, 75],
})

lazy_query = (
    df.lazy()
    .filter(pl.col("amount") > 100)
    .select("user")
)

result = lazy_query.collect()
